Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Biochemistry MBiochem at University of Oxford

What University of Oxford asks of applicants to Biochemistry MBiochem for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Oxford courses · Natural Sciences field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with APs/ACTs/SATs: three APs at grade 5 (including Chemistry and two other relevant subjects) plus ACT 32+ or SAT 1470+ — or four APs at grade 5 with no SAT/ACT

The department heads this “APs/ACTs/SATs”; it does not say “US high-school diploma” in those words.

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Biochemistry: Undergraduate admissions
English language
  • Higher level English language requirement (all Oxford courses)
  • IELTS (Academic recommended; IELTS Online not accepted): 7.5 overall, minimum 7.0 per component
  • TOEFL iBT: 110 overall (Listening 22, Reading 24, Speaking 25, Writing 24) — only tests taken up to and including 20 January 2026 are accepted
  • PTE Academic: 76 overall, minimum 66 in Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 191 overall, minimum 185 per component
    • Oxford Test of English (Advanced): 165, minimum 155 per component
  • All component scores from a single test session (no superscoring)
  • Not needed if English is your first language and you have always been a resident and citizen of a majority English-speaking country recognised by UKVI

Evidence is not needed at application; offer holders must meet the requirement by 31 July of the year of the offer. TOEFL tests taken from 21 January 2026 are not accepted while the new format is under review. Other accepted qualifications (e.g. Trinity ISE, GCSE/IGCSE English, IB English B at HL 7) and exemptions (e.g. an English-taught IB) are listed on the English language page. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

The department’s shortlisting criteria list no admissions test, and no test is mentioned anywhere on its admissions page.

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Biochemistry: Undergraduate admissions
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Chemistry
  • Helpful, not required: Mathematics, Biology

Chemistry is essential. Mathematics is very helpful (and makes an application more competitive) and Biology is helpful; neither is required.

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Biochemistry: Undergraduate admissions
A-Level requirements
Grades
A*AA
Required subjects
Chemistry
Preferred subjects
Mathematics, Biology

A*AA including Chemistry and another science or maths, with the A* in maths, physics, chemistry or biology. Chemistry is essential; Maths is very helpful and Biology helpful, neither required. Unconfirmed in the engine: the second subject must be “another science or maths” (one of several), which the matcher cannot express.
